notes.title: Delta Z: Improving Productivity Through Renovation
notes.content:
[p]Hello employees, prospective hires, and shareholders![/p][p]We have been working hard in the background to improve the Delta Z experience to better align with our goal of providing affordable reanimant aid to the masses! Now that factory renovations have progressed, we are eager to move our workers into their new and improved offices so they can be more productive than ever. Here is a quick run-down of the changes so far:

[/p][list][*][p]Our studies show that a smaller workspace is not only more energy efficient, but is also better overall for employee productiveness. With less space to move around in, technicians can quickly arrive at their workstation and begin work with minimal downtime. For employees who are claustrophobic, 3.7 seconds will be allotted at the start of every shift for calming deep-breathing exercises.[/p][/*][*][p]The reanimant reassignment workstation is now fitted with new desks and a table. Chairs may be provided at a later time if employee efficiency levels improve adequately.[/p][/*][*][p]Two more monitors have been installed, and the reassignment software has been accordingly updated to provide a more detailed viewing experience. The order fulfillment menu, reanimant status monitor, and parts catalog now each have their own screen. With how much this will improve work efficiency, we appreciate our employees accepting a reduced paycheck to help pay for the new equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]A “confirm” button has been added for new employees entering in their preferred name.[/p][/*][*][p]Several minor software bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Due to complaints from some visually-impaired shareholders, the text size for our daily bulletin has been adjusted to allow for easier reading.[/p][/*][*][p]And finally, our marketing department has a brand-new advertisement poster! Once available, we encourage our employees to purchase multiple copies and post them in their workplace and in high-traffic areas around their homes to improve morale.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We at Delta Z thank you for your continued support and look forward to further developments as factory renovations continue.[/p][p]
[/p]
